declarations.description:
A line chart over a time or numeric x axis, drawn on canvas by uPlot.

Series are declared as `c2-chart-series` children — the same authoring shape as `c2-table`'s columns —
or through the `series` property. With neither, one line is drawn per numeric key of the first row.

```html
<c2-line-chart x-type="time" x-field="t" legend="bottom" data='[{ "t": 1704067200000, "cpu": 12 }]'>
  <c2-chart-series field="cpu" label="CPU"></c2-chart-series>
</c2-line-chart>
```

Realtime feeds should call `appendPoint()` rather than reassigning `data`: it writes into the frame's
spare capacity and redraws without a Lit update.

members.name: inferredSeries
members.description:
The series to draw when nothing was declared: every numeric field of the first row except the ones
already spoken for by `x-field` and `label-field`.

circular — the frame is built *from* the series list — and naming the results positionally would be

members.name: legendItems
members.description:
What the legend lists. One entry per series for every cartesian chart — but a chart whose data is one
dimensional overrides this: a pie has a single series and many slices, and listing "Revenue" above a
four-slice donut tells the reader nothing.

members.name: renderLegend
members.description:
The legend box and its slot. The generated entries are not part of this template: they are rendered into the
slot, as its fallback content, after every update (`#renderLegendEntries`). A server cannot see the chart's
`c2-chart-series` children, so entries it rendered would name inferred series, and hydration keeps
server-rendered values without patching them, so the page would show them for good.

members.name: legendDependsOnData
members.description: Whether changing chart data can change the legend model. Pie charts use row labels as entries.

members.name: reshapesFrame
members.description:
Whether a change reshapes the frame, so the rows must be read again. `x-field`, `label-field` and `x-type`
always do, and so does the series list: definitions that arrive after `data` would otherwise leave the frame
holding the columns inferred from the first row. A chart with more row fields (the bubble chart's size) adds
its own. The builder's signature cache makes a change that reads the same fields free.

members.name: updateData
members.description:
Replaces the data without going through the update queue. Equivalent to assigning `data`, but skips
Lit's scheduling — worth it in a tight loop.

members.name: appendPoint
members.description:
Appends one point across every series at a shared x. The frame grows in place, so nothing is
re-normalised and no Lit update is scheduled: a 10 Hz feed costs one engine redraw per tick.

members.name: resolvedSeries
members.description: The series in draw order: `c2-chart-series` children when present, otherwise the `series` property.

members.name: inferredSeries
members.description:
The series to draw when nothing was declared: every numeric field of the first row except the ones
already spoken for by `x-field` and `label-field`.

This reads `data` rather than the normalised frame on purpose. Deriving it from the frame would be
circular — the frame is built *from* the series list — and naming the results positionally would be
worse than circular: the next normalisation would look up a field that does not exist in the rows and
quietly read every value as a gap.

members.description: The engine reports a hovered datum, or `null` when the pointer leaves. A chart with its own events extends this.

members.name: #setHover
members.description:
Positions the tooltip imperatively. A pointer move must not schedule a Lit update, so fixed coordinates
are written straight to the node; only a change of hovered index re-renders, and only when the body is
actually dynamic.

members.name: #syncTooltipPopover
members.description:
The built-in tooltip remains part of this shadow tree so slots, parts and inherited chart variables keep
working, but a manual popover promotes its box to the top layer. That escapes the plot's paint clipping
and any `overflow: hidden` ancestor without moving consumer-owned nodes into `document.body`.

members.description: Places the top-layer bubble above its datum, flipping and shifting it at viewport edges.

members.description: The `point-hover`/`point-click` detail for a datum, or `undefined` to fire neither.

members.name: handleEngineClick
members.description:
The engine reports a clicked datum: `point-click` fires, and unless a listener cancels it the clicked series is
highlighted, or the highlight cleared when it already was. A chart with its own events extends this.

members.name: highlightKeyAt
members.description:
What a click on this datum highlights: its series field. A chart with a single series has nothing to set apart,
so it returns `undefined`; a pie overrides this to name the slice.

members.name: formatX
members.description: Formats an x value for the tooltip. Time charts get a date, everything else a number.

members.name: xSpan
members.description:
How much time the chart currently covers, in milliseconds, or `0` when that is not a meaningful question.
Axis labels are chosen from it: a day of five-minute samples and a year of daily ones want different ticks.

members.name: formatValue
members.description: Formats a y value for the tooltip and the built-in labels.

members.name: renderTooltipBody
members.description: Named slot, then the renderer property, then the built-in rows — the library's three-layer fallback.

members.name: legendItems
members.description:
What the legend lists. One entry per series for every cartesian chart — but a chart whose data is one
dimensional overrides this: a pie has a single series and many slices, and listing "Revenue" above a
four-slice donut tells the reader nothing.

members.name: renderLegend
members.description:
The legend box and its slot. The generated entries are not part of this template: they are rendered into the
slot, as its fallback content, after every update (`#renderLegendEntries`). A server cannot see the chart's
`c2-chart-series` children, so entries it rendered would name inferred series, and hydration keeps
server-rendered values without patching them, so the page would show them for good.

events.name: tooltip-change
events.description: Fired with the complete tooltip model as the pointer moves, and with `null` when it leaves. Used by `c2-chart-tooltip`.

events.name: series-toggle
events.description: Fired when a series is hidden or shown, from the legend with `legend-action="toggle"` or through `setSeriesVisible`. Does not bubble.

events.name: series-highlight
events.description: Fired when the reader highlights a series, from the legend or by clicking it in the plot, or clears the highlight. `detail.key` names it, or is `null`. Does not bubble.

events.name: legend-change
events.description: Fired when legend entries or visibility change. Used by `c2-chart-legend`.

events.name: range-change
events.description: Fired after the user zooms or brushes. `detail.min` and `detail.max` are the new x bounds. Does not bubble.

events.name: chart-ready
events.description: Fired after the engine has loaded and drawn for the first time. The host also gains `data-chart-ready`, which is what a test should wait on.

events.name: chart-error
events.description: Fired when the engine fails to load or to draw. `detail.error` is the underlying failure.

events.name: point-hover
events.description: Fired as the pointer moves between data points, and with a `null` detail when it leaves the plot. Does not bubble.

Fired when a datum is clicked; the chart then highlights the clicked series (a second click on it clears the highlight). Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the highlight as it is. Does not bubble: several components fire point events, so a listener belongs on the element itself.

declarations.description:
A bar chart drawn by uPlot's bars path builder, for categorical or time-bucketed values. Several series
are drawn side by side within each band.

```html
<c2-bar-chart label-field="team" legend="bottom" data='[{ "team": "Core", "shipped": 18 }]'>
  <c2-chart-series field="shipped" label="Shipped"></c2-chart-series>
</c2-bar-chart>
```

attributes.name: legend
attributes.description:

unreadable without one, and a single-series chart simply renders a one-entry legend.

attributes.name: legend-action
attributes.description:

second click clears the highlight, just as a click on the series in the plot does; `toggle` hides or shows the
series instead. A linked `c2-chart-legend` follows the same mode.

attributes.name: highlighted

attributes.name: tooltip
attributes.description: Whether the tooltip follows the whole x position or only the hovered datum.

attributes.name: animation
attributes.description:

lightweight plot reveal; subsequent data updates stay immediate so a live source does not animate
every tick. Named `animation` rather than `animate` because `HTMLElement.animate()` is a method every

members.name: resolvedSeries
members.description: The series in draw order: `c2-chart-series` children when present, otherwise the `series` property.

members.name: inferredSeries
members.description:
The series to draw when nothing was declared: every numeric field of the first row except the ones
already spoken for by `x-field` and `label-field`.

This reads `data` rather than the normalised frame on purpose. Deriving it from the frame would be
circular — the frame is built *from* the series list — and naming the results positionally would be
worse than circular: the next normalisation would look up a field that does not exist in the rows and
quietly read every value as a gap.

members.name: #setHover
members.description:
Positions the tooltip imperatively. A pointer move must not schedule a Lit update, so fixed coordinates
are written straight to the node; only a change of hovered index re-renders, and only when the body is
actually dynamic.

members.name: #syncTooltipPopover
members.description:
The built-in tooltip remains part of this shadow tree so slots, parts and inherited chart variables keep
working, but a manual popover promotes its box to the top layer. That escapes the plot's paint clipping
and any `overflow: hidden` ancestor without moving consumer-owned nodes into `document.body`.

members.name: #positionTooltip
members.description: Places the top-layer bubble above its datum, flipping and shifting it at viewport edges.

members.name: handleEngineClick

members.name: xSpan
members.description:
How much time the chart currently covers, in milliseconds, or `0` when that is not a meaningful question.

members.name: formatValue
members.description: Formats a y value for the tooltip and the built-in labels.

members.name: renderTooltipBody
members.description: Named slot, then the renderer property, then the built-in rows — the library's three-layer fallback.

members.name: renderLegend

members.name: min
members.description: Lowest value on the gauge scale.

members.name: max

members.name: startAngle
members.description: Angle where the arc starts, in degrees counter-clockwise from three o'clock.

members.name: endAngle
members.description: Angle where the arc ends, in degrees counter-clockwise from three o'clock.

members.name: splitNumber
members.description: Number of labelled divisions around the arc.

members.name: precision
members.description: Maximum number of decimal places shown in the current value.

members.name: valueSuffix

members.name: progress

members.name: pointer

members.name: marks

members.name: seriesOption

members.description: Whether engine updates wait for the next frame. See `createEchartsAdapter`; a chart turns it off only for a reason.

members.name: createAdapter

members.name: projectData
members.description: Projects the normalised frame into the shape this engine consumes.

members.description: Builds the engine options from the theme and the resolved series. Never sees raw data.

members.name: data
members.description:
The data to plot. Row objects, a bare `number[]`, columnar `[xs, ys…]`, or an already-normalised
frame. Compared by identity: replace the array, or bump `revision` after mutating it in place.

members.name: revision
members.description: Bump after mutating `data` in place. The cheap escape hatch for a large buffer you own.

members.name: dataSource
members.description: Lazy or streaming source used instead of `data`. Property only.

members.name: series
members.description: Series definitions, as an alternative to `c2-chart-series` children. Children win when both are set.

members.name: xField
members.description: Row field holding the x value; may be a dotted path. Defaults to the row index.

members.name: labelField
members.description:
Row field holding each row's label: the slice names of a pie, the category axis of a bar chart, and the x tick
labels of a line, area or sparkline chart (`label-field="month"`, or `"year"` to print 2021 rather than 2,021).

members.name: xType
members.description: How x values are interpreted, which decides the axis and the tooltip format.

members.name: legendAction
members.description:
What clicking a legend entry does. `highlight` (the default) emphasises the series and dims the others, and a
second click clears the highlight, just as a click on the series in the plot does; `toggle` hides or shows the
series instead. A linked `c2-chart-legend` follows the same mode.

members.name: highlighted
members.description:
Key of the series drawn emphasised, the others dimmed: the series `field`, or a pie's slice label, or an overlap
chart's set key. Set by a legend click in `highlight` mode, and settable from the application in either mode.

members.name: animation
members.description:
Whether the chart animates its initial draw. ECharts uses its native shape animation and uPlot uses a
lightweight plot reveal; subsequent data updates stay immediate so a live source does not animate
every tick. Named `animation` rather than `animate` because `HTMLElement.animate()` is a method every
element already has, and shadowing it breaks the Web Animations API on the host.

members.description: BCP 47 locale for the axis and tooltip formatting. Defaults to the browser locale.

members.description: Shows the loading state instead of the plot.

members.name: maxPoints
members.description: Caps how many points a streaming chart keeps; older points fall off the front. `0` keeps everything.

members.description: Defers loading the engine until the host first scrolls into view.

members.description: Renders the tooltip body from a function instead of the `tooltip` slot. Property only.

members.description: Guards against two `createChart` runs racing while the engine chunk is in flight.

members.name: restoreVisibility
members.description: Restores interaction state after an engine instance is created or replaced.

members.name: validationError
members.description:
A problem with the input this chart type cannot draw, shown in the error state like `error` but owned by
the chart rather than the author. Empty when the input is drawable.

members.name: legendDependsOnData
members.description: Whether changing chart data can change the legend model. Pie charts use row labels as entries.

members.name: reshapesFrame
members.description:
Whether a change reshapes the frame, so the rows must be read again. `x-field`, `label-field` and `x-type`
always do, and so does the series list: definitions that arrive after `data` would otherwise leave the frame
holding the columns inferred from the first row. A chart with more row fields (the bubble chart's size) adds
its own. The builder's signature cache makes a change that reads the same fields free.

members.name: updateData
members.description:
Replaces the data without going through the update queue. Equivalent to assigning `data`, but skips
Lit's scheduling — worth it in a tight loop.

members.name: appendPoint
members.description:
Appends one point across every series at a shared x. The frame grows in place, so nothing is
re-normalised and no Lit update is scheduled: a 10 Hz feed costs one engine redraw per tick.

members.name: setSeriesVisible
members.description: Shows or hides one series, as the legend does.

members.name: highlight
members.description: Highlights a series, slice or set by key, or clears the highlight with `null`, and fires `series-highlight`.

members.name: legendEntryState
members.description:
The `key`, `pressed`, `dimmed` and `toggle` of one legend entry under the current `legend-action`. Every chart's
`legendItems` goes through this, so a linked `c2-chart-legend` follows the mode without knowing it.

members.name: getLegendItems
members.description: Current entries for a linked `c2-chart-legend`.

members.name: getTooltipContext
members.description: Current hover model for a linked `c2-chart-tooltip`.

members.name: getPlotBounds
members.description: Plot bounds used to place a linked floating tooltip in viewport coordinates.

members.name: registerLegendPresenter
members.description: Registers an external legend and suppresses the built-in legend until it disconnects.

members.name: unregisterLegendPresenter
members.description: Removes an external legend registration.

members.name: registerTooltipPresenter
members.description: Registers an external tooltip and suppresses the built-in tooltip until it disconnects.

members.name: unregisterTooltipPresenter
members.description: Removes an external tooltip registration.

members.name: notifyLegendChange
members.description: Notifies linked legends after a subclass changes a data-shaped legend such as pie slices.

members.name: resolvedSeries
members.description: The series in draw order: `c2-chart-series` children when present, otherwise the `series` property.

members.name: inferredSeries
members.description:
The series to draw when nothing was declared: every numeric field of the first row except the ones
already spoken for by `x-field` and `label-field`.

This reads `data` rather than the normalised frame on purpose. Deriving it from the frame would be
circular — the frame is built *from* the series list — and naming the results positionally would be
worse than circular: the next normalisation would look up a field that does not exist in the rows and
quietly read every value as a gap.

members.name: colorOf
members.description: The colour a series draws with: its own `color`, else its palette slot.

members.name: #canRender
members.description: True once there is something to draw and somewhere to draw it.

members.name: handleEngineHover

type.text: { index: number; seriesIndex: number; px: number; py: number } | null

members.description: The engine reports a hovered datum, or `null` when the pointer leaves. A chart with its own events extends this.

members.name: #setHover
members.description:
Positions the tooltip imperatively. A pointer move must not schedule a Lit update, so fixed coordinates
are written straight to the node; only a change of hovered index re-renders, and only when the body is
actually dynamic.

members.name: #syncTooltipPopover
members.description:
The built-in tooltip remains part of this shadow tree so slots, parts and inherited chart variables keep
working, but a manual popover promotes its box to the top layer. That escapes the plot's paint clipping
and any `overflow: hidden` ancestor without moving consumer-owned nodes into `document.body`.

members.name: #positionTooltip
members.description: Places the top-layer bubble above its datum, flipping and shifting it at viewport edges.

members.name: tooltipContextAt

type.text: { index: number; seriesIndex: number; px: number; py: number }

members.description: The tooltip model for a hovered datum. A chart whose data is not a frame of series columns overrides it.

members.name: pointAt
members.description: The `point-hover`/`point-click` detail for a datum, or `undefined` to fire neither.

members.name: handleEngineClick
members.description:
The engine reports a clicked datum: `point-click` fires, and unless a listener cancels it the clicked series is
highlighted, or the highlight cleared when it already was. A chart with its own events extends this.

members.name: highlightKeyAt
members.description:
What a click on this datum highlights: its series field. A chart with a single series has nothing to set apart,
so it returns `undefined`; a pie overrides this to name the slice.

members.name: formatX
members.description: Formats an x value for the tooltip. Time charts get a date, everything else a number.

members.name: xSpan
members.description:
How much time the chart currently covers, in milliseconds, or `0` when that is not a meaningful question.
Axis labels are chosen from it: a day of five-minute samples and a year of daily ones want different ticks.

members.name: formatValue
members.description: Formats a y value for the tooltip and the built-in labels.

members.name: renderTooltipBody
members.description: Named slot, then the renderer property, then the built-in rows — the library's three-layer fallback.

members.name: legendItems
members.description:
What the legend lists. One entry per series for every cartesian chart — but a chart whose data is one
dimensional overrides this: a pie has a single series and many slices, and listing "Revenue" above a
four-slice donut tells the reader nothing.

members.name: renderLegend
members.description:
The legend box and its slot. The generated entries are not part of this template: they are rendered into the
slot, as its fallback content, after every update (`#renderLegendEntries`). A server cannot see the chart's
`c2-chart-series` children, so entries it rendered would name inferred series, and hydration keeps
server-rendered values without patching them, so the page would show them for good.

members.name: renderLegendExtras
members.description: Content drawn after the series entries in the built-in legend, such as the bubble chart's size key.

events.description: Fired with the complete tooltip model as the pointer moves, and with `null` when it leaves. Used by `c2-chart-tooltip`.

events.name: series-toggle
events.description: Fired when a series is hidden or shown, from the legend with `legend-action="toggle"` or through `setSeriesVisible`. Does not bubble.

events.name: series-highlight
events.description: Fired when the reader highlights a series, from the legend or by clicking it in the plot, or clears the highlight. `detail.key` names it, or is `null`. Does not bubble.

events.name: legend-change
events.description: Fired when legend entries or visibility change. Used by `c2-chart-legend`.

events.name: range-change
events.description: Fired after the user zooms or brushes. `detail.min` and `detail.max` are the new x bounds. Does not bubble.

events.name: chart-ready
events.description: Fired after the engine has loaded and drawn for the first time. The host also gains `data-chart-ready`, which is what a test should wait on.

events.name: chart-error
events.description: Fired when the engine fails to load or to draw. `detail.error` is the underlying failure.

events.name: point-hover
events.description: Fired as the pointer moves between data points, and with a `null` detail when it leaves the plot. Does not bubble.

Fired when a datum is clicked; the chart then highlights the clicked series (a second click on it clears the highlight). Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the highlight as it is. Does not bubble: several components fire point events, so a listener belongs on the element itself.

declarations.description:
A radar chart drawn by ECharts. Each data row is an indicator named by `label-field`; each
`c2-chart-series` is one comparable profile drawn across those indicators.

```html
<c2-radar-chart label-field="metric" max="100"
  data='[{"metric":"Quality","current":82,"target":90},{"metric":"Speed","current":74,"target":85}]'>
  <c2-chart-series field="current" label="Current"></c2-chart-series>
  <c2-chart-series field="target" label="Target"></c2-chart-series>
</c2-radar-chart>
```

declarations.description:
A bubble chart drawn by ECharts: a scatter plot whose third measure is the area of each point. `x-field` and
`y-field` place a bubble and `size-field` sizes it; `label-field` names it in the tooltip and on the bubble.

Rows come in either of two shapes:

- **One row per point, grouped** (`series-field`): each row names its series, and `y-field` holds the value.
  The series are the distinct values of that field, in the order they first appear; a `c2-chart-series` whose
  `field` is one of those values relabels or recolours it, and declaring them limits the chart to them.
- **One column per series**: each `c2-chart-series` reads its own `field` as the y value, as on
  `c2-scatter-chart`, and a row may carry only one series' field.

```html
<c2-bubble-chart x-field="gdp" y-field="life" size-field="pop" label-field="country" series-field="region"
  x-scale="log" data='[{ "country": "Brazil", "region": "Americas", "gdp": 10040, "life": 75.8, "pop": 216 }]'>
</c2-bubble-chart>
```

Size maps to area — the diameter grows with the square root of the value — between `--c2-chart__bubble--min-size`
and `--c2-chart__bubble--max-size`, so a value twice as large looks twice as large. Larger bubbles are drawn first
within each series so the small ones stay on top and hoverable. The built-in legend ends with a key to the sizes.

declarations.description:
A Venn diagram of two or three sets, drawn by ECharts. Each set is a circle and each overlap is the area the
circles share, labelled with the number of members in exactly that combination.

Declare the sets with `c2-chart-series`, where `field` is the set's key, and pass one `data` row per
combination with the number of members in *all* of its sets. A combination left out counts as 0, and the
chart works out every exclusive region from those totals.

```html
<c2-overlap-chart data='[
    { "sets": ["web"], "size": 18420 }, { "sets": ["mobile"], "size": 12960 }, { "sets": ["api"], "size": 4310 },
    { "sets": ["web", "mobile"], "size": 6880 }, { "sets": ["web", "api"], "size": 2150 },
    { "sets": ["mobile", "api"], "size": 1020 }, { "sets": ["web", "mobile", "api"], "size": 740 }
  ]'>
  <c2-chart-series field="web" label="Web app"></c2-chart-series>
  <c2-chart-series field="mobile" label="Mobile app"></c2-chart-series>
  <c2-chart-series field="api" label="Public API"></c2-chart-series>
</c2-overlap-chart>
```

The legend switches a set off and lays the diagram out again without it. With more than three sets the chart
shows its error state, because circles cannot draw every region of four sets.

The sets are named in the chart's legend, all in one place (`legend` positions it). `set-labels="around"` writes
each set's name and total beside its circle instead. Hovering a legend entry, or a name, highlights the whole
circle, and clicking highlights it; `highlighted` does the same from the application (a row of a table next to the
chart, say). On a `selectable` chart, clicking a region selects that region and clicking a set's name selects the
whole set.

The plot is one tab stop: the arrow keys move through the sets and then the regions from the largest to the
smallest, Enter selects the focused one when `selectable` is set, and Escape clears the focus and the selection.

`renderTooltip` and `tooltip-change` receive an `OverlapTooltipContext`, which carries the hovered `region` or
`set` on top of the shared tooltip model.

members.name: features
members.description: The ECharts modules this chart type needs registered. Keeps the rest of the library unloaded.

members.name: lazyEngineUpdates
members.description: Whether engine updates wait for the next frame. See `createEchartsAdapter`; a chart turns it off only for a reason.

members.name: setsField
members.description: Row field holding the set keys of a combination.

members.name: sizeField
members.description: Row field holding the number of members in all of the combination's sets.

members.name: layout
members.description:
`proportional` sizes the circles and their overlaps by the counts; with three sets the triple overlap is a
best fit, since three circles cannot match every combination exactly. `uniform` draws equal circles so
every region has room for its label.

members.name: setLabelPlacement
members.description:
Where the sets are named. `none` (the default) names them in the legend alone, grouped in one place that
`legend` positions; `around` also writes each set's name and total beside its circle, where hovering or clicking
the name highlights the set. With `around` the legend is usually redundant, so pair it with `legend="none"`.

members.name: labels
members.description: What each region shows: its member count, its share of all members, both (`6,140 · 23.3%`), or nothing.

members.name: selectable
members.description: Lets the reader select a region by clicking it or pressing Enter, which fires `selection-change`.

members.name: selected
members.description: Set keys of the selected region, for example `["web", "api"]`; `selected="web;api"` as an attribute.

members.name: selection
members.description:
What a click inside the circles selects. `region` (the default) selects the exclusive region under the pointer;
`set` selects a whole circle: the smallest one under the pointer, and the next one there on each further click,
until the selection clears. Hovering then highlights the circle a click would select. A set's name always
selects its set.

members.name: selectedSet
members.description: Key of the selected set: its whole circle is selected. Clears `selected` when the reader picks a set.

members.name: format
members.description: Formats the counts in the labels and the tooltip. Falls back to the chart's number format. Property only.

members.name: focusedMask
members.description: The region the keyboard focus is on, as its mask.

members.name: focusedSet
members.description: The set the keyboard focus is on, by key. Never set together with `focusedMask`.

members.name: hoveredSet
members.description: The set whose name or legend entry the pointer or the focus is on, by key.

members.name: #hoverKind
members.description: What the last engine hover was on, so leaving it fires the matching `null` event.

members.name: #pointerSet
members.description: The set whose name the pointer is on, for the plot's DOM click.

members.name: #pointerRegion
members.description: The region the pointer is on, for the plot's DOM click in `selection="set"` mode.

members.name: regions
members.description: Every exclusive region of the visible sets, including empty ones, largest first. For a table view or an export.

members.name: regionName
members.description: The readable name of a region: `Web app only`, `Web app + Public API`.

members.name: setDetail
members.description: A set's totals, as `set-hover` and `set-click` report them. `undefined` for a set that is not visible.

members.name: setSeriesVisible
members.description: Switches a set off or on, as the legend does, and lays the diagram out again. The last visible set stays on.

members.name: createAdapter
members.description: Sets are toggled by recomputing the layout, so the engine is never asked to hide one of its own series.

members.name: validationError
members.description:
A problem with the input this chart type cannot draw, shown in the error state like `error` but owned by
the chart rather than the author. Empty when the input is drawable.

members.name: legendItems
members.description: Hovering or focusing a legend entry highlights that set's circle.

members.name: legendDependsOnData
members.description: Whether changing chart data can change the legend model. Pie charts use row labels as entries.

members.name: inferredSeries
members.description: Without declared sets, every key that appears in a row is a set, in order of first appearance.

members.name: coordinateSystem
members.description: Grid and axes for a cartesian chart. The pie and gauge charts override this to contribute neither.

members.name: seriesOption
members.description: The option object for one series.

members.name: buildOptions
members.description: Builds the engine options from the theme and the resolved series. Never sees raw data.

members.name: projectData
members.description: One datum per circle for the fill and outline series, and one per drawable region in between.

members.name: tooltipContextAt

type.text: { index: number; seriesIndex: number; px: number; py: number }

members.description: The tooltip model for a hovered datum. A chart whose data is not a frame of series columns overrides it.

members.name: pointAt
members.description: A region is not a point: `point-hover` and `point-click` stay quiet and the region events fire instead.

members.name: handleEngineHover

type.text: { index: number; seriesIndex: number; px: number; py: number } | null

members.description: The engine reports a hovered datum, or `null` when the pointer leaves. A chart with its own events extends this.

members.name: handleEngineClick
members.description:
The engine reports a clicked datum: `point-click` fires, and unless a listener cancels it the clicked series is
highlighted, or the highlight cleared when it already was. A chart with its own events extends this.

members.name: #rows
members.description: The rows as `{ sets, size }`, whatever the fields are called. Rows without a set list are skipped.

members.name: #probeColor
members.description:
A colour variable resolved to `rgb(…)` through a hidden probe, as the chart theme does: `getPropertyValue`
would hand back a `var()` or `color-mix()` chain no engine can parse. A transparent result means "unset".

members.name: #layoutPixels
members.description: Scales the model into the plot and places every label. Cached per size, model and label mode.

type.text: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; r: number }

members.name: #activeSet
members.description: The set drawn emphasised, if any: the hovered one, else the focused one, else the one the application highlights.

members.name: #regionColor
members.description: A single set's region wears its colour in the tooltip; an overlap wears the text colour.

members.name: #activate
members.description: Click or Enter: fires `region-click` and, on a selectable chart, toggles the selection.

members.name: #activateSet
members.description: Click on a set's name, or Enter on it: fires `set-click` and, on a selectable chart, toggles the set's selection.

members.name: #setCandidates
members.description: The sets a region lies in, smallest circle first: the order a click in `selection="set"` mode walks.

members.name: #activateSetAt
members.description: A click, or Enter, on a region in `selection="set"` mode: selects the next circle there, then none.

members.name: #focusRegion
members.description: Moves the keyboard focus onto a region and shows its tooltip, as hovering it would.

members.name: #focusSet
members.description: Moves the keyboard focus onto a set's name and shows its tooltip, as hovering the name would.

members.name: tooltip
members.description: Whether the tooltip follows the whole x position or only the hovered datum.

members.name: engineName
members.description: Which engine this chart draws with.

members.name: renderer
members.description: Which ECharts renderer to use. SVG prints and scales crisply; canvas is faster with many marks.

members.name: dataShape
members.description: Cartesian charts want `[x, y]` pairs; the labelled ones want `{ name, value }`.

members.name: data
members.description:
The data to plot. Row objects, a bare `number[]`, columnar `[xs, ys…]`, or an already-normalised
frame. Compared by identity: replace the array, or bump `revision` after mutating it in place.

members.name: revision
members.description: Bump after mutating `data` in place. The cheap escape hatch for a large buffer you own.

members.name: dataSource
members.description: Lazy or streaming source used instead of `data`. Property only.

members.name: series
members.description: Series definitions, as an alternative to `c2-chart-series` children. Children win when both are set.

members.name: xField
members.description: Row field holding the x value; may be a dotted path. Defaults to the row index.

members.name: labelField
members.description:
Row field holding each row's label: the slice names of a pie, the category axis of a bar chart, and the x tick
labels of a line, area or sparkline chart (`label-field="month"`, or `"year"` to print 2021 rather than 2,021).

members.name: xType
members.description: How x values are interpreted, which decides the axis and the tooltip format.

members.name: legend
members.description:
Where the legend sits, or `none` to hide it. Shown by default: a chart with more than one series is
unreadable without one, and a single-series chart simply renders a one-entry legend.

members.name: legendAction
members.description:
What clicking a legend entry does. `highlight` (the default) emphasises the series and dims the others, and a
second click clears the highlight, just as a click on the series in the plot does; `toggle` hides or shows the
series instead. A linked `c2-chart-legend` follows the same mode.

members.name: highlighted
members.description:
Key of the series drawn emphasised, the others dimmed: the series `field`, or a pie's slice label, or an overlap
chart's set key. Set by a legend click in `highlight` mode, and settable from the application in either mode.

members.name: animation
members.description:
Whether the chart animates its initial draw. ECharts uses its native shape animation and uPlot uses a
lightweight plot reveal; subsequent data updates stay immediate so a live source does not animate
every tick. Named `animation` rather than `animate` because `HTMLElement.animate()` is a method every
element already has, and shadowing it breaks the Web Animations API on the host.

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP 47 locale for the axis and tooltip formatting. Defaults to the browser locale.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows the loading state instead of the plot.

members.name: error
members.description: Shows an error message instead of the plot.

members.name: emptyMessage
members.description: Replaces the built-in "no data" text.

members.name: maxPoints
members.description: Caps how many points a streaming chart keeps; older points fall off the front. `0` keeps everything.

members.name: lazyRender
members.description: Defers loading the engine until the host first scrolls into view.

members.name: renderTooltip
members.description: Renders the tooltip body from a function instead of the `tooltip` slot. Property only.

members.name: renderLegendItem
members.description: Renders one legend entry from a function instead of the `legend` slot. Property only.

members.name: #creating
members.description: Guards against two `createChart` runs racing while the engine chunk is in flight.

members.name: restoreVisibility
members.description: Restores interaction state after an engine instance is created or replaced.

members.name: reshapesFrame
members.description:
Whether a change reshapes the frame, so the rows must be read again. `x-field`, `label-field` and `x-type`
always do, and so does the series list: definitions that arrive after `data` would otherwise leave the frame
holding the columns inferred from the first row. A chart with more row fields (the bubble chart's size) adds
its own. The builder's signature cache makes a change that reads the same fields free.

members.name: updateData
members.description:
Replaces the data without going through the update queue. Equivalent to assigning `data`, but skips
Lit's scheduling — worth it in a tight loop.

members.name: appendPoint
members.description:
Appends one point across every series at a shared x. The frame grows in place, so nothing is
re-normalised and no Lit update is scheduled: a 10 Hz feed costs one engine redraw per tick.

members.name: highlight
members.description: Highlights a series, slice or set by key, or clears the highlight with `null`, and fires `series-highlight`.

members.name: legendEntryState
members.description:
The `key`, `pressed`, `dimmed` and `toggle` of one legend entry under the current `legend-action`. Every chart's
`legendItems` goes through this, so a linked `c2-chart-legend` follows the mode without knowing it.

members.name: getLegendItems
members.description: Current entries for a linked `c2-chart-legend`.

members.name: getTooltipContext
members.description: Current hover model for a linked `c2-chart-tooltip`.

members.name: getPlotBounds
members.description: Plot bounds used to place a linked floating tooltip in viewport coordinates.

members.name: registerLegendPresenter
members.description: Registers an external legend and suppresses the built-in legend until it disconnects.

members.name: unregisterLegendPresenter
members.description: Removes an external legend registration.

members.name: registerTooltipPresenter
members.description: Registers an external tooltip and suppresses the built-in tooltip until it disconnects.

members.name: unregisterTooltipPresenter
members.description: Removes an external tooltip registration.

members.name: notifyLegendChange
members.description: Notifies linked legends after a subclass changes a data-shaped legend such as pie slices.

members.name: resolvedSeries
members.description: The series in draw order: `c2-chart-series` children when present, otherwise the `series` property.

members.name: colorOf
members.description: The colour a series draws with: its own `color`, else its palette slot.

members.name: #canRender
members.description: True once there is something to draw and somewhere to draw it.

members.name: #setHover
members.description:
Positions the tooltip imperatively. A pointer move must not schedule a Lit update, so fixed coordinates
are written straight to the node; only a change of hovered index re-renders, and only when the body is
actually dynamic.

members.name: #syncTooltipPopover
members.description:
The built-in tooltip remains part of this shadow tree so slots, parts and inherited chart variables keep
working, but a manual popover promotes its box to the top layer. That escapes the plot's paint clipping
and any `overflow: hidden` ancestor without moving consumer-owned nodes into `document.body`.

members.name: #positionTooltip
members.description: Places the top-layer bubble above its datum, flipping and shifting it at viewport edges.

members.name: highlightKeyAt
members.description:
What a click on this datum highlights: its series field. A chart with a single series has nothing to set apart,
so it returns `undefined`; a pie overrides this to name the slice.

members.name: formatX
members.description: Formats an x value for the tooltip. Time charts get a date, everything else a number.

members.name: xSpan
members.description:
How much time the chart currently covers, in milliseconds, or `0` when that is not a meaningful question.
Axis labels are chosen from it: a day of five-minute samples and a year of daily ones want different ticks.

members.name: formatValue
members.description: Formats a y value for the tooltip and the built-in labels.

members.name: renderTooltipBody
members.description: Named slot, then the renderer property, then the built-in rows — the library's three-layer fallback.

members.name: renderLegend
members.description:
The legend box and its slot. The generated entries are not part of this template: they are rendered into the
slot, as its fallback content, after every update (`#renderLegendEntries`). A server cannot see the chart's
`c2-chart-series` children, so entries it rendered would name inferred series, and hydration keeps
server-rendered values without patching them, so the page would show them for good.

members.name: renderLegendExtras
members.description: Content drawn after the series entries in the built-in legend, such as the bubble chart's size key.

events.name: set-hover
events.description: Fired as the pointer or the keyboard focus moves onto a set's name, and with a `null` detail when it leaves. Does not bubble.

events.name: region-hover
events.description: Fired as the pointer or the keyboard focus moves onto a region, and with a `null` detail when it leaves. Does not bubble.

events.name: region-click
events.description: Fired when a region is clicked or chosen with Enter. `detail.sets` names its sets, `detail.size` counts the members in exactly those sets and `detail.total` those in all of them. Does not bubble.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired when the reader selects or clears a region or a set of a `selectable` chart. `detail.selected` holds the selected region's set keys and `detail.selectedSet` the selected set's key. Does not bubble.

Fired when a set's name is clicked, or chosen with Enter; the set is then highlighted (a second click clears it). Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the highlight as it is. `detail.total` counts its members and `detail.only` those in no other set. Does not bubble.
events.name: set-click
tooltip-change
events.description: Fired with the complete tooltip model as the pointer moves, and with `null` when it leaves. Used by `c2-chart-tooltip`.

events.name: series-toggle
events.description: Fired when a series is hidden or shown, from the legend with `legend-action="toggle"` or through `setSeriesVisible`. Does not bubble.

events.name: series-highlight
events.description: Fired when the reader highlights a series, from the legend or by clicking it in the plot, or clears the highlight. `detail.key` names it, or is `null`. Does not bubble.

events.name: legend-change
events.description: Fired when legend entries or visibility change. Used by `c2-chart-legend`.

events.name: range-change
events.description: Fired after the user zooms or brushes. `detail.min` and `detail.max` are the new x bounds. Does not bubble.

events.name: chart-ready
events.description: Fired after the engine has loaded and drawn for the first time. The host also gains `data-chart-ready`, which is what a test should wait on.

events.name: chart-error
events.description: Fired when the engine fails to load or to draw. `detail.error` is the underlying failure.

events.name: point-hover
events.description: Fired as the pointer moves between data points, and with a `null` detail when it leaves the plot. Does not bubble.

Fired when a datum is clicked; the chart then highlights the clicked series (a second click on it clears the highlight). Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the highlight as it is. Does not bubble: several components fire point events, so a listener belongs on the element itself.
events.name: point-click

declarations.description:
Shared behaviour of every `c2-*-chart`: the chrome and its slots, the resize observer, theme
resolution, data normalisation, and the routing that keeps a realtime update off the expensive path.
It defines no tag and is never registered — the concrete charts extend it.

**Why the data and presentation inputs are separate.** `data` and `revision` are the only properties on
the data path; everything else is presentation. A change limited to the data path is pushed straight
into the engine from `shouldUpdate`, which returns `false`, so Lit never renders or commits and the
canvas container is not touched. Anything else rebuilds the engine options, which is allowed to be
expensive. That is what makes a streaming tick cost one engine redraw and nothing more.

**Sizing.** A canvas has no intrinsic size, so the host is sized by `--c2-chart--height` (320px by
default) rather than by its content. Give the host a height — through the variable, a CSS rule, or a
flex parent — or the plot area collapses.

members.name: inferredSeries
members.description:

already spoken for by `x-field` and `label-field`.

members.description:
The built-in tooltip remains part of this shadow tree so slots, parts and inherited chart variables keep
working, but a manual popover promotes its box to the top layer. That escapes the plot's paint clipping
and any `overflow: hidden` ancestor without moving consumer-owned nodes into `document.body`.

type.text: { index: number; seriesIndex: number; px: number; py: number }

members.description: The tooltip model for a hovered datum. A chart whose data is not a frame of series columns overrides it.

members.name: pointAt
members.description: The `point-hover`/`point-click` detail for a datum, or `undefined` to fire neither.

members.name: handleEngineClick
members.description:
The engine reports a clicked datum: `point-click` fires, and unless a listener cancels it the clicked series is
highlighted, or the highlight cleared when it already was. A chart with its own events extends this.

members.name: highlightKeyAt
members.description:
What a click on this datum highlights: its series field. A chart with a single series has nothing to set apart,
so it returns `undefined`; a pie overrides this to name the slice.

members.name: formatX
members.description: Formats an x value for the tooltip. Time charts get a date, everything else a number.

members.name: xSpan
members.description:
How much time the chart currently covers, in milliseconds, or `0` when that is not a meaningful question.
Axis labels are chosen from it: a day of five-minute samples and a year of daily ones want different ticks.

members.name: formatValue
members.description: Formats a y value for the tooltip and the built-in labels.

members.name: renderTooltipBody
members.description: Named slot, then the renderer property, then the built-in rows — the library's three-layer fallback.

members.name: legendItems
members.description:
What the legend lists. One entry per series for every cartesian chart — but a chart whose data is one
dimensional overrides this: a pie has a single series and many slices, and listing "Revenue" above a
four-slice donut tells the reader nothing.

members.name: renderLegend
members.description:
The legend box and its slot. The generated entries are not part of this template: they are rendered into the
slot, as its fallback content, after every update (`#renderLegendEntries`). A server cannot see the chart's
`c2-chart-series` children, so entries it rendered would name inferred series, and hydration keeps
server-rendered values without patching them, so the page would show them for good.

members.name: renderLegendExtras
members.description: Content drawn after the series entries in the built-in legend, such as the bubble chart's size key.

members.name: legend
members.description:
Where the legend sits, or `none` to hide it. Shown by default: a chart with more than one series is
unreadable without one, and a single-series chart simply renders a one-entry legend.

members.name: legendAction
members.description:

members.name: highlighted
members.description:

members.name: animation

members.name: legendDependsOnData

members.name: reshapesFrame
members.description:
Whether a change reshapes the frame, so the rows must be read again. `x-field`, `label-field` and `x-type`
always do, and so does the series list: definitions that arrive after `data` would otherwise leave the frame
holding the columns inferred from the first row. A chart with more row fields (the bubble chart's size) adds
its own. The builder's signature cache makes a change that reads the same fields free.

members.name: updateData
members.description:
Replaces the data without going through the update queue. Equivalent to assigning `data`, but skips
Lit's scheduling — worth it in a tight loop.

members.name: appendPoint
members.description:
Appends one point across every series at a shared x. The frame grows in place, so nothing is
re-normalised and no Lit update is scheduled: a 10 Hz feed costs one engine redraw per tick.

members.name: resolvedSeries
members.description: The series in draw order: `c2-chart-series` children when present, otherwise the `series` property.

members.name: inferredSeries
members.description:
The series to draw when nothing was declared: every numeric field of the first row except the ones
already spoken for by `x-field` and `label-field`.

This reads `data` rather than the normalised frame on purpose. Deriving it from the frame would be
circular — the frame is built *from* the series list — and naming the results positionally would be
worse than circular: the next normalisation would look up a field that does not exist in the rows and
quietly read every value as a gap.

members.name: #setHover
members.description:
Positions the tooltip imperatively. A pointer move must not schedule a Lit update, so fixed coordinates
are written straight to the node; only a change of hovered index re-renders, and only when the body is
actually dynamic.

members.name: #syncTooltipPopover
members.description:
The built-in tooltip remains part of this shadow tree so slots, parts and inherited chart variables keep
working, but a manual popover promotes its box to the top layer. That escapes the plot's paint clipping
and any `overflow: hidden` ancestor without moving consumer-owned nodes into `document.body`.

members.name: xSpan
members.description:
How much time the chart currently covers, in milliseconds, or `0` when that is not a meaningful question.
Axis labels are chosen from it: a day of five-minute samples and a year of daily ones want different ticks.

members.name: formatValue

members.name: renderTooltipBody

members.name: legendItems
members.description:
What the legend lists. One entry per series for every cartesian chart — but a chart whose data is one
dimensional overrides this: a pie has a single series and many slices, and listing "Revenue" above a
four-slice donut tells the reader nothing.

members.name: renderLegend
members.description:
The legend box and its slot. The generated entries are not part of this template: they are rendered into the
slot, as its fallback content, after every update (`#renderLegendEntries`). A server cannot see the chart's
`c2-chart-series` children, so entries it rendered would name inferred series, and hydration keeps
server-rendered values without patching them, so the page would show them for good.

events.name: tooltip-change
events.description: Fired with the complete tooltip model as the pointer moves, and with `null` when it leaves. Used by `c2-chart-tooltip`.

events.name: series-toggle
events.description: Fired when a series is hidden or shown, from the legend with `legend-action="toggle"` or through `setSeriesVisible`. Does not bubble.

events.name: series-highlight
events.description: Fired when the reader highlights a series, from the legend or by clicking it in the plot, or clears the highlight. `detail.key` names it, or is `null`. Does not bubble.

events.name: legend-change
events.description: Fired when legend entries or visibility change. Used by `c2-chart-legend`.

events.name: range-change
events.description: Fired after the user zooms or brushes. `detail.min` and `detail.max` are the new x bounds. Does not bubble.

events.name: chart-ready
events.description: Fired after the engine has loaded and drawn for the first time. The host also gains `data-chart-ready`, which is what a test should wait on.

events.name: chart-error
events.description: Fired when the engine fails to load or to draw. `detail.error` is the underlying failure.

events.name: point-hover
events.description: Fired as the pointer moves between data points, and with a `null` detail when it leaves the plot. Does not bubble.

Fired when a datum is clicked; the chart then highlights the clicked series (a second click on it clears the highlight). Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the highlight as it is. Does not bubble: several components fire point events, so a listener belongs on the element itself.

members.name: handleEngineClick
members.description:
The engine reports a clicked datum: `point-click` fires, and unless a listener cancels it the clicked series is
highlighted, or the highlight cleared when it already was. A chart with its own events extends this.

members.name: highlightKeyAt
members.description:
What a click on this datum highlights: its series field. A chart with a single series has nothing to set apart,
so it returns `undefined`; a pie overrides this to name the slice.

members.name: formatX
members.description: Formats an x value for the tooltip. Time charts get a date, everything else a number.

members.name: xSpan
members.description:
How much time the chart currently covers, in milliseconds, or `0` when that is not a meaningful question.
Axis labels are chosen from it: a day of five-minute samples and a year of daily ones want different ticks.

members.name: formatValue
members.description: Formats a y value for the tooltip and the built-in labels.

members.name: renderTooltipBody
members.description: Named slot, then the renderer property, then the built-in rows — the library's three-layer fallback.

members.name: legendItems
members.description:
What the legend lists. One entry per series for every cartesian chart — but a chart whose data is one
dimensional overrides this: a pie has a single series and many slices, and listing "Revenue" above a
four-slice donut tells the reader nothing.

members.name: renderLegend
members.description:
The legend box and its slot. The generated entries are not part of this template: they are rendered into the
slot, as its fallback content, after every update (`#renderLegendEntries`). A server cannot see the chart's
`c2-chart-series` children, so entries it rendered would name inferred series, and hydration keeps
server-rendered values without patching them, so the page would show them for good.

members.name: renderLegendExtras
members.description: Content drawn after the series entries in the built-in legend, such as the bubble chart's size key.

attributes.name: renderer
attributes.description: Which ECharts renderer to use. SVG prints and scales crisply; canvas is faster with many marks.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description:
The data to plot. Row objects, a bare `number[]`, columnar `[xs, ys…]`, or an already-normalised
frame. Compared by identity: replace the array, or bump `revision` after mutating it in place.

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Bump after mutating `data` in place. The cheap escape hatch for a large buffer you own.

attributes.name: series
attributes.description: Series definitions, as an alternative to `c2-chart-series` children. Children win when both are set.

attributes.name: x-field
attributes.description: Row field holding the x value; may be a dotted path. Defaults to the row index.

attributes.name: label-field
attributes.description:
Row field holding each row's label: the slice names of a pie, the category axis of a bar chart, and the x tick
labels of a line, area or sparkline chart (`label-field="month"`, or `"year"` to print 2021 rather than 2,021).

attributes.name: x-type
attributes.description: How x values are interpreted, which decides the axis and the tooltip format.

attributes.name: legend
attributes.description:
Where the legend sits, or `none` to hide it. Shown by default: a chart with more than one series is
unreadable without one, and a single-series chart simply renders a one-entry legend.

attributes.name: legend-action
attributes.description:
What clicking a legend entry does. `highlight` (the default) emphasises the series and dims the others, and a
second click clears the highlight, just as a click on the series in the plot does; `toggle` hides or shows the
series instead. A linked `c2-chart-legend` follows the same mode.

attributes.name: highlighted
attributes.description:
Key of the series drawn emphasised, the others dimmed: the series `field`, or a pie's slice label, or an overlap
chart's set key. Set by a legend click in `highlight` mode, and settable from the application in either mode.

attributes.name: tooltip
attributes.description: Whether the tooltip follows the whole x position or only the hovered datum.

attributes.name: animation
attributes.description:
Whether the chart animates its initial draw. ECharts uses its native shape animation and uPlot uses a
lightweight plot reveal; subsequent data updates stay immediate so a live source does not animate
every tick. Named `animation` rather than `animate` because `HTMLElement.animate()` is a method every
element already has, and shadowing it breaks the Web Animations API on the host.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: BCP 47 locale for the axis and tooltip formatting. Defaults to the browser locale.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows the loading state instead of the plot.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Shows an error message instead of the plot.

attributes.name: empty-message
attributes.description: Replaces the built-in "no data" text.

attributes.name: max-points
attributes.description: Caps how many points a streaming chart keeps; older points fall off the front. `0` keeps everything.

attributes.name: lazy-render
attributes.description: Defers loading the engine until the host first scrolls into view.

events.name: tooltip-change
events.description: Fired with the complete tooltip model as the pointer moves, and with `null` when it leaves. Used by `c2-chart-tooltip`.

events.name: series-toggle
events.description: Fired when a series is hidden or shown, from the legend with `legend-action="toggle"` or through `setSeriesVisible`. Does not bubble.

events.name: series-highlight
events.description: Fired when the reader highlights a series, from the legend or by clicking it in the plot, or clears the highlight. `detail.key` names it, or is `null`. Does not bubble.

events.name: legend-change
events.description: Fired when legend entries or visibility change. Used by `c2-chart-legend`.

events.name: range-change
events.description: Fired after the user zooms or brushes. `detail.min` and `detail.max` are the new x bounds. Does not bubble.

events.name: chart-ready
events.description: Fired after the engine has loaded and drawn for the first time. The host also gains `data-chart-ready`, which is what a test should wait on.

events.name: chart-error
events.description: Fired when the engine fails to load or to draw. `detail.error` is the underlying failure.

events.name: point-hover
events.description: Fired as the pointer moves between data points, and with a `null` detail when it leaves the plot. Does not bubble.

Fired when a datum is clicked; the chart then highlights the clicked series (a second click on it clears the highlight). Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the highlight as it is. Does not bubble: several components fire point events, so a listener belongs on the element itself.
events.name: point-click
